Commentary.Commentary: Credit to the tourists for being on the money at the death. 375 was on the cards but the pace bowlers only conceded 14/3 in the last 3 overs. Still, it is an uphill task for Bangladesh on a track where the ball is stopping on odd occasions. The South Africans are favourites but stranger things have happened in cricket. Join us for the chase shortly.

AB de Villiers, who was making a comeback, took his time to begin with. After he was set, he entered into his destructive best. He tore the Bangladeshi attack apart, deflating their morale. The visitors didn't have any answer to his beast mode. The home side accumulated 98 in the last 10 overs but lost some momentum towards the end.

What a scintillating batting display from the Proteas! After losing the toss and being put into bat, Amla and de Kock were once again solid. They provided the perfect impetus but when they were running away with the show, Shakib sent de Kock packing. The skipper, du Plessis departed straightaway to a jaffa in the same over. A bit of wobble for the home side didn't trouble them though.

Excellent end to an excellent over. Just 3 runs and 2 wickets off it. Speared full around off, Behardien walks across to scoop it but misses it completely and it's taken by Mushfiqur Rahim behind the stumps. The batsmen are unable to take a single too. Good end from Bangladesh, SOUTH AFRICA FINISH ON 353/6!
Andile Phehlukwayo walks in next.

OUT! Two in two for Rubel Hossain, he's on a hat-trick here! Full and outside off, Pretorius kneels down in an attempt to bash it out of the park. Hits it with power but it's quite flat. Straight down the throat of Imrul Kayes at wide long off who takes a good catch.
Dwaine Pretorius comes out to bat.

OUT! He's gone! Extremely full on the stumps, Duminy tries whipping it away on the leg side but misses and is caught low on the back pad. Loud shout, but nothing from the umpire. Bangladesh have the review so they think they might as well use it. It's taken upstairs and replays show that the ball actually hit him right in front of middle stump. Some late swing did JP in. The southpaw walks back to the dressing room, something for the Tigers to smile about.
Goes for the yorker but just misses his mark. It's a low full toss which is hit towards the cover fielder. One more run taken.
Right in the blockhole, excellent stuff from Rubel. On middle and off, Duminy can only dig it out back down towards mid on for a quick single.
Full outside off, driven to long off for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single. Great over from Ahmed, only 5 from it.
Another front foot defense from Farhaan.
Defended off the front foot by Behardien presenting the full face of the bat.
In line of the stumps, Duminy swings his bat but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The batsmen sneak in a run.
Pinpoint yorker on off, Behardien jams it out beside the pitch on the off side and crosses over.
Full length delivery around off, Farhaan makes room and carves it to sweeper cover for a couple.
Taskin Ahmed comes back for a bowl.
On a length, Behardien places it to point for a run.
Full toss on leg stump, heaved to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Farhaan Behardien is the new man in.

OUT! AB de Villiers departs after a majestic knock! Low full toss on off, dipping in. AB kneels and heaves it over mid-wicket but doesn't get it off the meat of the bat. Sabbir Rahman in the deep pouches a comfortable catch. The dynamic South African gets a rousing applause from the crowd. The double ton was there for the taking the way he was going. He would have been the first middle order batsman to do so. Anyway, a brilliant effort from a sheer genius!
Angling into de Villiers, he kneels and goes for an agricultural slog. Gets it off the toe end to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Duminy hammers this one to mid on for a brisk run.
De Villiers anticipates this one and shuffles across his stumps. Gets it where he wanted and sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.
Rubel Hossain to bowl now.
SIX! Duminy gets into the act as well! Full length ball on off, Duminy heaves it over deep mid-wicket to clear the fence with ease. Bangladesh continue to leak runs, 18 from it again.
Full delivery, AB backs away and whips it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
SIX! He is absolutely toying with the Bangladeshi bowling! In the arc, de Villiers slams it over long on for a biggie.
FOUR! Hit hard! Fullish delivery on off, AB de Villiers tonks it over mid off for a boundary. This is now his highest ODI score.
Brilliant delivery. Full length delivery tailing in towards the boots, de Villiers looks to whip it across but misses it. Rahim dives to his left to collect it.
Back of a length ball on off, pulled in front of square leg for a run.
Tennis ball like bounce on this one. Outside off, de Villiers look to upper cut it but it is far away to connect. 18 from the over.
Full length delivery on middle, hammered to mid on.

SIX! Slower delivery on a good length on leg stump, de Villiers murders it over deep square leg for yet another maximum. He is in that kind of zone that the South African crowd is just loving it, contrasting for the visitors though.
FOUR! Doesn't matter where you bowl to him, he will carve you away for runs. Full length ball well outside off, de Villiers cracks it over extra cover for a rocketing boundary.

SIX! This man is special! Full toss on leg stump, de Villiers whips it over deep mid-wicket for half a dozen. Didn't time it that well but the ball still sailed way over the fence. That brings up his 150, the second of his ODI career.
Full length delivery on middle, AB makes room and drills it past the bowler to long off. A couple taken.
Turns this one through mid-wicket for a run and will retain strike. 15 from the over.
SIX! Poor bowling from the skipper. He again opts to go short, de Villiers expects it and hammers it over deep mid-wicket for back-to-back maximums!
SIX! Adding insult to injury! Short delivery at a slow pace, de Villiers swivels across and pulls it with disdain over cow corner for a biggie.

DROPPED! Fullish delivery angling in from outside off, JP Duminy goes for a slog across the line but ends up getting a leading edge towards point. Imrul Kayes stays grounded, lines it up but puts down a sitter.
Off-cutter outside off, Duminy tries to drop and run but Rahim is quick to get to it. Denies the single.
Short delivery on middle, pulled through backward square leg for a run.
Flighted ball outside off, driven crisply to sweeper cover for a run.
Uses his feet and drags his heave to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Shakib fires this one wide outside off. AB reaches out to it and slams it to extra cover.

SIX! Boom! AB de Villiers makes room and Shakib follows him. Bowls it on a flatter trajectory too. However, AB is in such kind of form that he deals with it so easily. Pulls it over deep square leg for a maximum.
Turns this one around the corner to rotate strike.
Camps back and punches it to covers.
Slower off-cutter on a length, AB backs away looking to open up the off side but fails to connect. As Rahim collects the ball, he starts to limp. Not good sings for Bangladesh.

FOUR! He is watching the ball like a football! Fuller in length on off, de Villiers makes room, uses his feet and lifts it over wide mid off to pick up another boundary. The 50-run stand comes up between the duo.
Length delivery outside off, JP leans into it and eases it to deep cover-point. A run taken.
Back of a length outside off, Duminy steers it to third man. Ahmed rushes to his right, attacks the ball but isn't able to prevent the second.
Slow bouncer on off, de Villiers lines it up and plays a controlled pull to deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
Short and width on offer, Duminy slaps it to deep point for a run.
FOUR! Brilliant! Floated in line of the stumps, de Villiers backs away and slices it through point to find the fence.
Fraction short this time, knocked down to long on to rotate strike.
Outside off, AB places it to sweeper cover for a run.
Clips this one with the angle through square leg for a run.
Similar delivery, JP hangs back and punches it to deep mid-wicket. Good running between the wickets allows the batsmen to come back for second.
Starts off with a flat delivery on off, tucked with the spin to mid-wicket.
Shakib Al Hasan is back on. Can he get the all-important wicket of de Villiers?
Another slower one outside off, Duminy slaps it to deep point for a run and will retain strike.
Works this one with the angle around the corner for a run.

Well bowled! Slower delivery on a short length in line of the stumps, de Villiers makes room and looks to force it over covers but gets foxed. This kind of delivery will be effective on this slowish track.
Mortaza comes from around the wicket and bowls an off-cutter on off. Duminy is early into his push and ends up chipping it towards the bowler. He gets a hand to it but fails to prevent the single.
Shortish delivery on off, de Villiers gets on top of it and pulls it to deep mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. A maximum of five fielders can be allowed at the fence. Mashrafe Mortaza to bowl now.
Short ball around middle, pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
This ball is nudged down to fine leg for one run.
Length ball around off, guided to third man for a run.

In the air... lands in no man's land! Mashrafe Mortaza is not happy with the effort and is seen fuming at Rubel Hossain. Ahmed bangs it short around off, de Villiers goes for the pull but isn't in control. Gets a top edge that lands near deep backward square leg. The fine leg and deep mid-wicket fielders get there but the ball isn't catchable for both of them.
Length ball on the pads, tucked away through square leg for one run.
Very full around middle and leg, belted down to long on for a single.
Taskin Ahmed back on.
De Villiers turns it through mid-wicket and retains strike.
This ball is flicked off the pads through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
This ball is punched through covers for a single.

FOUR! Nasir fires it shortish around off, de Villiers camps back and cuts it through cover-point. A slight misfield there allows the batsman a boundary. Not the kind of effort that the Bangladeshis would be proud of.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.

There it is, century no. 25 in ODIs for Abraham Benjamin de Villiers! How easily has he walked into international cricket after taking a break. Top, top knock. He turns it through mid-wicket and crosses over to get to the landmark.
Full around off and middle, de Villiers straight drives that nicely. The mid on fielder dives to parry it towards long off. Two runs taken.
FOUR! Wonderfully struck. Rubel hurls it fuller around middle and leg, de Villiers plays it with the angle and collects a boundary through mid-wicket.
Landed in line of the stumps, flicked away through mid-wicket for a brace.
Length ball around off, Duminy gets an outside edge towards third man for a run.
Fuller outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
This ball is punched back to the bowler.
Looped up around off, Duminy charges down but gets it off the outer half towards backward point.
This ball is turned round the corner for a run.
Flatter around off, punched through covers for a single. Duminy gets off the mark.
Floated around off and middle, driven towards long on for one run.
Fired on the pads, de Villiers tickles it towards fine leg for a brace.
Jean-Paul Duminy is the next man in.

OUT! Amla has to walk back. Rubel strikes. A soft dismissal you have to say. Served in the channel of uncertainty outside off, Amla feels for it and only manages a thin edge that Rahim happily accepts. A wonderful knock by the bearded batsman comes to an end. He deserved a ton but doesn't get it. Is this the breakthrough that could help them create further inroads?
On a length around middle, de Villiers moves his front foot out of the way and hits it on the up over the bowler. Kayes chases it down and the slow outfield helps him save a run for his side.
Sprayed on the pads, flicked through backward square leg for a run.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers for a brace.

Very full delivery around leg, de Villiers digs it out towards short fine leg. They risk a run and complete it even as the fielder has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. Amla would have been in, had it hit, though.
Short ball around off, pulled away towards mid-wicket.
Flicked away to mid-wicket from the crease.
Another run collected after playing it down to long on.
Served on the pads, de Villiers shoulders arms. But the ball goes off his thigh pads to the keeper.
Flatter around middle, driven down to long on for one run.
Floated around off, knocked down to long on for a single.
Looped up around off, reverse swept through short third man for a brace.
Nasir Hossain back on.
FOUR! Amla continues milking boundaries. Full ball outside off, Amla drives it beautifully through covers. The ball races away to the fence in no time.
Landed around off, Amla blocks it off the front foot.
This ball is flicked through mid-wicket for a brace.
Fine leg goes back.
Hurls a full delivery around off and middle, the ball moves in a tad. AB flicks it through mid-wicket to collect a run.
Rubel spears in a full length ball around off and middle, the ball stays a touch low. Amla taps it in front of covers and hares over to the other end.
Bowled on a length around off and middle, de Villiers stands tall and clips it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Rubel Hossain is running into bowl now. It's high time for him to use his experience and show his effectiveness by getting among the wickets quickly.

Drinks have been taken. South Africa are running away with this game yet again. De Villiers and Amla are looking in fine touch, with the former showing ominous signs for the visitors. The tourists have their task cut out to restrict the opposition to a total that they can achieve.
Flatter around off, knocked down to long on for one run.
Hashim knocks this down to long on for one run.
Tosses it in line of the stumps, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated around middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy ball outside off, driven through covers for a brace.
Flatter on off, Amla goes back and punches it through cover-point. Before the fielder retrieves the ball, a brace taken.
Served outside off, driven to long off for a run.
Another single collected by AB after playing it through mid on.
This ball is driven to mid on.

SIX! Another gift dealt with in the right manner. Nasir loops it up and ends up serving yet another full toss. De Villiers moves to the leg side and bashes it up and over deep mid-wicket for half a dozen. Brings up the 100-run stand between these two. This is the 12th such stand between these two, the most by a pair for South Africa in ODIs.
Amla drives it to long on and crosses over for a run.
Flatter on the pads, turned round the corner for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Flatter on the pads, worked away through square leg for one run.
This ball is played through mid off for a run.
Tossed up outside off, AB de Villiers gets it off the outer half of the bat past the keeper. Taskin from short third man ambles towards the ball. Three runs taken before that.
WIDE! Flatter down the leg side, de Villiers misses the flick. Wide signaled.
Flatter outside off, played through backward point for a single.
Bowled outside off, de Villiers drives it through covers for a run.
Mahmudullah is brought into the attack now. In the past few minutes, Mortaza is ringing in the changes frequently.
Floated around off, driven through mid off for a single.
Flicked off his pads but straight to the fielder at short fine leg.
Tossed up around off and middle, punched on the up to long on for a single.
Darted in line of the stumps, hit back to the bowler.
This ball is driven down to long on for a single.
Loopy delivery around middle and leg, turned towards mid on.
Again change of ends for Nasir Hossain.
This ball is driven through mid off for a run.
Floated around off, driven through covers for a one.
This ball is flicked away off his pads for a run.
FOUR! And de Villiers continues to get freebies in Paarl. A juicy full toss outside off, de Villiers just thumps it through the cover region for a boundary.
This ball is nudged down fine to short fine leg.

FOUR! Rahman starts off with a half tracker outside off, de Villiers goes back and slaps it through covers for a boundary. 54th ODI fifty for Mr. 360! How good he has looked today! After surviving some nervy moments initially, he has set out to do what he does best - maul the opposition.
Sabbir Rahman to roll his arm over now.
This ball is flicked off his pads to deep mid-wicket for a run.

Very full around off, de Villiers digs it back to the bowler. He got overbalanced a bit and ends up veering out of the crease. Taskin fields it and has a shy at the stumps at the striker's end but misses. The keeper misses collecting it and concedes a brace.
Taskin Ahmed aborts his run-up just before he got to the crease. Seems like the ball just slipped in his hands.
Landed outside off, driven on the up by Amla through covers for a single.
Now he flicks it through mid-wicket and crosses over to the other side.

FOUR! Authoritative Abraham! Ahmed hurls it on a length outside off, de Villiers charges down and goes up and over mid off for a boundary. When this guy is in such murderous mood, it is tough to stop him.
WIDE! Taskin runs in and bangs it wide outside off. The batsman lets that go. Wide given.
Short ball around off, pulled away through square leg for a run.
Amla collects a single after playing it down to long on.
Flatter around off, pushed back towards the bowler.
Looped up outside off, driven through mid off for a brace.
This ball is pushed to mid on.
Floated around middle, driven through mid on for a single.
Fuller around off, knocked down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Dismissed from his presence. Ahmed hurls a length delivery around off and middle, de Villiers charges down the track and bashes it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Awesome Abraham! Fuller ball outside off, de Villiers drives it nicely through covers for a boundary. The fielder in the deep tries to use his feet to stop that but fails.
Landed around off, pushed to point.
This is worked away through backward square leg for a run.

Amla would have been a goner! A tad fuller outside off, Amla blocks it towards point. He wants a run but is sent back late. The fielder hurls a throw at the striker's end but misses. Replays show that the batsman was in the air as he tried to make it in.
Begins with a length ball around middle and leg, flicked towards square leg.
Taskin Ahmed is back in to bowl.

FOUR! Poor ball, punished! Nasir tosses a low full toss around middle and leg. De Villiers pounces on the opportunity to collect runs. He sweeps it powerfully in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Flatter around middle, pushed back towards the bowler.
Amla picks up a run after playing it to long on.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, punched towards covers.
Similar delivery, AB de Villiers works it round the corner and crosses over to the other end.
Flatter on the pads, worked away through backward square leg for a run.
Nasir Hossain back into the attack.
FOUR! Shakib darts it shorter around off and middle, de Villiers goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. He makes batting look so easy when he is on a roll.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Served around middle, de Villiers goes back and punches it through covers for a single.
Flatter in line of the stumps, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball around off, driven down to long off for a run.
Serves it around off, Amla plays it through covers for one run.
That's the 34th ODI fifty for Hashim Amla. The run-machine for the Proteas continues what he does best. Amla collects a single after pushing it through covers.
Hurled around middle and leg, flicked to the fielder at deep mid-wicket for a run.
Finds the mid-wicket fielder with a flick.
Fuller ball around off, driven through covers for a brace.
Amla plays it through the cover region for a run.

FOUR! Mortaza isn't helping his side by leaking boundaries. Length delivery outside off, Amla stays deep in the crease and cuts it through backward point. The ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
This ball is played safely to long on for one.
Loopy ball around off, driven to long off for a single.
Floated outside off, de Villiers drives it through covers. He gets a brace.
This ball is punched to the fielder at covers.
Tossed up around middle and off, de Villiers lets the ball come on before dead-batting it.
Flatter in line of the stumps, Amla goes back and works it through square leg for a run.
Now he finds the mid off fielder with this push.
Almost plays it on. ABD looks to cut it but chops it over the stumps. No harm done.

FOUR! One brings two. Back-to-back boundaries for the Protea star! Length delivery around off, de Villiers just stays put and clips it through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep didn't stand a chance to cut that off. The master is back doing what he does best.
FOUR! AB de Villiers gets going with his first boundary. Bowled fuller around off, AB gets his stride forward and drives it just wide of mid off. The ball speeds away to the fence.
WIDE! Short ball down the leg side, AB looks to pull it but aborts it. Wide signaled.
Length delivery around off, de Villiers gets it off the inner half towards mid on.
That's bowled on the pads, Amla clips it away towards fine leg for a run.
Mashrafe Mortaza brings himself back into the attack.
Loopy ball outside off, beautifully played through covers for a brace.
Another delivery in line of the stumps is blocked off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, defended off the front foot showing the full face of the bat.
This ball is played through covers for a single.

Edged but safe! Nasir Hossain at first slip did not react to that at all. Shakib serves it flatter around middle, de Villiers goes back to punch it but gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies through the keeper and the slip for three runs. That's 19000 international runs for AB de Villiers.
Finds the mid on fielder with the punch.
This ball is pushed through covers for another run.

A big moment in the game! Run out chance missed against de Villiers. Hossain bowls it outside off, Amla looks to punch but mistimes it towards mid on. He takes a start in a bid to take a run. De Villiers responds but is sent back. Mahmudullah rushes to the ball to run him out but fails to take the ball. Ends up conceding a run eventually.
Landed outside off, Amla punches it to the point fielder.
AB de Villiers gets off the mark with a back foot punch. It was bowled around off, and played through covers.
Length delivery outside off, Amla stands tall and punches it through covers for a run.
In walks AB de Villiers. He has not played an ODI since long so he will be tested.

OUT! Timber! Shakib Al Hasan floats it around middle, spins ever so slightly to beat the outstretched bat of du Plessis. The ball crashes into the stumps leaving du Plessis bewildered. All of a sudden the Bangla Tigers are roaring and right back in the game. Two quick wickets for the man who has done almost everything for his side.
Angles it around middle, punched back to the bowler off the back foot.
Fuller around off, du Plessis comes forward and defends it.
Faf du Plessis is the new man in.

OUT! Shakib strikes! Fuller around off, de Kock looks to turn it through the leg side but fails to connect. The ball strikes him on the pads and the players appeal. The umpire upholds it as it looked pretty plumb. Quinton does not waste the review and walks off. The opening stand is broken in time. Bangladesh take a wicket after 514 deliveries! Finally, some relief for them.
Angles it around middle, punched through covers for a single by Hashim Amla.
Fuller on middle, de Kock comes down and pushes it through mid on for a single.
Length ball outside off, driven square of the wicket to point.
Good length outside off, punched to mid off. De Kock takes on Mahmudullah there who fumbles and allows a single.
Shorter in length around off and middle, pulled through square leg for a single.
Taps it towards covers for a single.

The straighter boundaries are longer than usual which will mean the batsmen will have to work that bit harder. The square boundaries are relatively shorter but since there is little pace on the wicket, it will be hard to force the ball in those areas.
De Kock turns it through square leg for a couple of runs.
Good length outside off, Amla punches it towards covers and takes off for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Run taken safely in the end.
Drinks!
Comes forward and turns it towards mid-wicket.
In the gap! Quinton slinks down the wicket and lofts it over mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Flatter around middle, Amla comes down and looks to turn it through. Does not connect cleanly but de Kock calls him through for a run. Leg bye signaled.
Turns one through square leg for a single.
Angles it around middle and leg, de Kock backs away and punches it towards covers.
Pushed through covers for a single.
Good length around off, nudged through backward square leg for a single.
WIDE! Good stop, Rahim! Rubel slants one around middle and leg, Amla looks to shuffle and clip but fails to do so. Rahim dives to his left and stops the ball.
Shorter in length outside off, does not come as expected by Hashim. He miscues his pull towards mid-wicket. That came off the toe end of the bat.
Similar length again outside off, tapped towards third man for a single.
Good length outside off, Amla dabs it towards third man for a single.
Short ball around off and middle, climbing on Amla, he pulls it off the top edge towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Top effort! Good length around off, worked through mid-wicket by de Kock. Das in the deep does well to slide near the fence and stop the ball from going through. Saves a run for his side.
Loopy ball around middle, flicked away for a run.
Served fuller around middle and leg, driven down to long on for a single.
This ball is worked through square leg for a run.
Loopy ball around off, de Kock charges down and pushes it towards covers.
Darted around off and middle, Hashim stays back and punches it to long on for a single.
Tosses it up around off, driven to long on for a run.
This ball is flicked off his pads for a single through square leg.
Amla lets this one come to him and opens the face of the bat to collect a run towards third man.
Back of a length delivery around middle and off, de Kock looks to heave it away but wears it on the thigh pads. There is a huge scream by Rahim as he appeals to no avail. The batsmen steal a leg bye.
Rubel hurls it on the pads, de Kock tucks it through backward square leg for a brace. There was a slight misfield in the deep as Sabbir took his eye off the ball early.
Similar delivery around off, Hashim plays it with a slightly angled bat this time. Gets a run as the ball goes to sweeper cover.
Full ball around off, wonderfully driven to the cover fielder.
Shakib serves it around off, Quinton hits it straight to mid-wicket.
Floated around off and middle, punched down to long on for a single.
This ball is turned through square leg for one run.
Tossed up around off, swept away through backward square leg for a brace.
This ball is defended by lunging forward.
Flatter on the pads, flicked away through square leg for a run.
Shakib Al Hasan gets a change of ends.
De Kock finds mid off with this push.
Hurled outside off, guided away to third man for one run.
This ball is punched through covers for a single.
Landed on a length around off, de Kock looks to go big to the on side. Gets an inside edge onto his pads. No damage done though.
Length delivery around off, pushed to covers.
Runs in and bowls it on a length around off, de Kock punches it towards point.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. A maximum of 4 players can be allowed outside the inner circle. Rubel Hossain will steam in with the ball now. Will be interesting to see how he bowls on this surface.
Floated around off and middle, flicked through mid-wicket for one run. 50 up for South Africa.
Served in line of the stumps, flicked away through square leg for a run.
Flatter in line of the stumps, punched towards mid on.
This ball is driven to long on for a single.

The outfield helps Bangladesh save some runs! Hossain floats it around off, Amla goes up and over mid off. He waits for it thinking it to be a certain boundary. But the ball sticks on the field and doesn't roll to the fence. Seeing that the batsmen take three.
Begins with a flatter ball around off, slapped through covers for a run.
Taskin Ahmed is seen going off the field. Meanwhile, Nasir Hossain is brought in to bowl. The slower track and outfield might be the reason behind the spinners bowling so early in the innings.
Flatter in line of the stumps, pushed back towards the bowler.
Tossed up around off and middle, pushed to long on for a run.
This ball is flicked straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Floated in line of the stumps, flicked away through mid-wicket for a run.
Darted on a shorter length outside off, de Kock goes back and pulls it through mid on for a run.
Looped up outside off, driven down to long off for a run.
WIDE! Begins with a delivery down the leg side. Amla looks to flick but misses. Wide signaled.
Spin time! Shakib Al Hasan to have a bowl.
Served around off, the southpaw pushes it off the front foot towards covers.
WIDE! Ahmed sprays this down the leg side, Quinton doesn't bother playing that. Rahim has to dive to his right to collect that. The umpire stretches his arms there.
Bowled on a length around middle and leg, de Kock flicks it through square leg and calls for two immediately. The batsmen do complete the brace comfortably.
Hurled outside off, Hashim guides it to third man for a run.
This ball around off is pushed towards covers.
Length delivery around off, Amla guides it towards third man. Gets a brace before the fielder returns the throw. Good running yet again.
FOUR! Don't ball short deliveries to Amla. Just don't. He'll hit them at any time of the day. This delivery is pulled with disdain through square leg for a boundary.
6000 international runs for Quinton de Kock. This is bowled around off, the southpaw charges down and plays it aerially over wide mid off for a couple of runs.

Big appeal, turned down! Mortaza lands it on a length around leg. De Kock moves to the off side and looks to hoick it away but gets hit on the thighs. The players appeal but to no avail. Mashrafe thinks about the review but decides against it. Height is the factor.
Length ball around leg, de Kock makes room by moving to the leg side and pats it to the fielder at covers.
Another run collected by Amla after guiding it to third man.
Mortaza bowls it on the pads, de Kock flicks it through square leg for a run. There is a slight misfield in the deep but no extra run conceded.
Landed on a back of a length around off and middle, Quinton stays tall and punches it to covers.
This ball is glided to third man for a single.
A couple of days of pretty solid rain has slowed down the outfield considerably, inform the on-air commentators. No threat of rain today though.
Back of a length around off, Amla flicks it away through backward square leg for a run.
Now Taskin comes back over the wicket and bowls it on the pads, Quinton tucks it to fine leg for a run.
Smashed, but straight to Shakib at mid-wicket. Length ball around off and middle, Quinton pulls it off the front foot straight to the fielder there.
WIDE! Hurls it on a length down the leg side, de Kock looks to pull it away but misses.
Amla lets that one come to him and plays it through short third man for one run.

Well run again. These two have good understanding between them. Ahmed comes from round the wicket and bowls it full outside off, de Kock pushes it wide of mid off and takes a run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end to no avail though.
This ball is nicely punched but straight to the fielder at point.
Length ball around off, Amla punches it towards mid on. Wants a run initially but then decides against it.
This delivery on the pads is flicked through square leg for a run.
Back of a length delivery around middle, de Kock gets it off the bottom off his bat through backward point. The batsmen get a brace before the fielder returns the throw.
This is bowled around off, de Kock again mistimes his cut there.
Mortaza hurls it in at a gentle pace of around 122 kmph. De Kock lets that go. Rahim fails to take it cleanly as he gets an awkward bounce there. No run conceded though.
This ball is punched off the back foot towards covers.
This ball around off is glided down to third man for one run.
FOUR! Glorious shot from the blade of de Kock this time. Ahmed hurls it full around off, Quinton nicely gets forward and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Another good fielding effort, this time at point. Bowled outside off, Quinton cuts it hard only to be intercepted by the diving fielder there.
Length ball outside off, Quinton mistimes his cut and chops it next to the pitch on the off side.
Such efforts on the field will lift Bangladesh up. Fuller outside off, de Kock nicely cover drives that. Mahmudullah dives to his left to make a clean stop and prevent a certain boundary.
Another harmless delivery well outside off, Hashim doesn't bother playing at that.
Mortaza serves it on a length outside off, Amla points his bat skywards as he lets that go.

Excellent running! On a length outside off, Amla watches the ball well and guides it through backward point. Before the fielder from third man runs to his right to get to the ball, the batsmen complete two.
Mortaza runs in and aborts his run-up just before delivering the ball.
Lands around off, blocked from within the crease.

FOUR! That's the first boundary of the match. Amla's bat fetches that. It is bowled full outside off, Amla leans into it and drives it beautifully through covers. The ball rushes away to make contact with the boundary cushions.
Mashrafe lands it on a length on the pads, de Kock turns it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Another delivery around off, Amla defends that showing the full face of the bat. Taskin begins well, concedes just a run off this one.
This delivery around off is punched off the back foot towards point.
Length delivery around off, de Kock lets the ball come on. He opens the face of the bat and picks up a single towards third man.
Fuller around off, Quinton drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Landed around middle and leg, flicked away towards mid-wicket.
Ahmed begins with a short and wide ball outside off, de Kock cuts it straight to the fielder at point. Didn't really get it off the meat of the bat.
Taskin Ahmed will run in with the second new ball from the other end.
Landed around off, played defensively from within the crease. Just a couple of runs from the over.
Full outside off, Amla lets that go to the keeper.

A well-run, quick single gets Quinton going. He taps it from the crease towards the off side and sets off for a run. A slight hesitation from him but Amla was always intent on running that and he completes the run with ease.

Play and a miss, next up. De Kock is having some nervy moments out there. Hurled just around off, the batsman has a feel for it but misses. The ball passes from close to the edge of the bat, through to the keeper.
De Kock almost plays on! On a length around off, Quinton looks to push at it from the crease. Gets an inside edge onto his pads. Thankfully for him, the ball doesn't go onto the stumps.
Amla is off straightaway! Mortaza runs in and bowls it on a length around middle and leg. The batsman jumps and plays it towards backward square leg for a single.

The national anthems are done and dusted and we are set to get underway. The set up at the ground seems all good for a wonderful game of cricket. The openers Quinton de Kock and Hashim Amla stride out with the bat. They would aim to provide their side with a flying start yet again. With an aim to prevent just that, skipper Mashrafe Mortaza will steam in with the first brand new ball. Two slips in place. Let's play says the umpire.

TOSS - Bangladesh win the toss and opt to field. Both sides make one change each. The hosts bring in Farhaan Behardien for the injured David Miller while for the visitors the fit-again Tamim Iqbal replaces Mohammad Saifuddin.

A warm welcome to everyone for the second game of the ODI series between South Africa and Bangladesh played in Paarl. The hosts literally trampled down the visitors in the first game to romp home to a win. As much as they would love to do the same here, they would like to be challenged a bit more. The tourists' bowling woes refuse to end and they would want to shrug off the string of losses as quickly as possible. It would be interesting to see the team combinations that the away side opts to go with. Stay tuned with us for all the action.
